# Beau Monde Builders

> Ultra-luxury custom home builder and renovator on Florida's Space Coast. 30 years of bespoke residences led by AJ Hoover, Florida Certified Master Builder.

Beau Monde Builders designs and constructs custom oceanfront and waterfront estates throughout Brevard County — Rockledge, Cocoa Beach, Melbourne, Merritt Island, Satellite Beach, Indialantic, Viera, and the Space Coast. The firm also performs discreet whole-home and luxury condominium renovations.
